title: Why Do We Need Human Mathematicians Anymore?
author: Po-Shen Loh

metaphors.title: Faster than you can steer
metaphors.paraphrase: Driving faster than you can run is fine, not faster than you can steer; AI multiplies the “control points” that need skilled humans.

metaphors.title: Olympics and Formula 1
metaphors.paraphrase: If robots outrun humans, do we cancel the Olympics? F1 already exists alongside them.
metaphors.author: Readers on Loh's post

metaphors.title: A proof with a hole is a poof
metaphors.paraphrase: Also HAL 9000 and WALL-E's AUTO, and a backlash like Three Mile Island or Chernobyl.

metaphors.title: A baby controlling its mother
metaphors.paraphrase: Hinton's only example of a less intelligent thing controlling a more intelligent one (quoted).

metaphors.title: Assembly versus source code
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematicians make proofs readable as source code is to assembly; AI is Hilbert's program, humans Gödel's theorem.
metaphors.author: Readers on Loh's post
